name: Sakuramori Akasha
source:
Akasha is a 3rd-year student which means she’s one year older than the [url=/c881]protagonist[/url]. She’s... weird. In too many ways. Also she’s really clever but doesn’t seem like it. The head of the Garden Committee but she doesn’t do much work and instead rolls and lazes around. Quite a mysterious girl. Her family is also very influential apparently.
